author: Alexandra Mae Jones
description: Gleeks, ready your slushies — the wacky, irreverent musical dramedy that broke barriers and launched careers in the 2010s is officially getting a reboot, and several original cast members have indicated they’re coming back for the ride.
title: A Glee reboot is officially happening, and fans are buzzing

author: Christine Pagulayan
description: Canadian actor Carrie-Anne Moss reflects on her path from Vancouver to The Matrix, and the experiences that shaped her acting career. She also discusses returning to British Columbia for Yaga, motherhood and her concerns about AI's impact on storytelling.
title: From The Matrix to Yaga, Carrie-Anne Moss still believes rejection can open the right door

author: Rhianna Schmunk
description: Guests staying in an Airbnb will soon have fewer chores to do before they check out after their stay. The short-term rental company has updated its policies to restrict how much cleaning hosts can ask guests to undertake before they leave.
title: Airbnb limiting the checkout chores hosts can ask guests to do

description: Ukrainian forces say they completed the world’s first front-line aerial drone evacuation of an injured soldier. Andrew Chang explains how, breaking down engineering challenges and physical risks behind the operation. Images provided by The Canadian Press, Reuters, Adobe Stock and Getty Images
title: Ukraine says this drone can fly injured soldiers off the front line | About That

description: As our days shorten and temperatures drop, chlorophyll in leaves breaks down, revealing the autumnal tones of yellow and orange, while some leaves develop brilliant reds. Check out the fall splendour in Canada.
title: IN PHOTOS | Fall splendour in Canada

author: Olivia Le ‌Poidevin
description: The El Niño weather pattern could cause a record rise in ocean temperatures in the Pacific as it barrels ‌around the globe like a "wrecking ball" causing floods and droughts, UN officials said on Wednesday.
title: El Niño breaks warming records in the Pacific Ocean, foreshadowing more extreme weather to come, UN says

author: Marie Chabot-Johnson, Fannie Olivier
description: A new analysis shows some progress in Prime Minister Mark Carney's use of French in public addresses.
title: French content in Carney's speeches rises from 17% to 23%

author: Alina Snisarenko
description: A Mississauga man serving a 40-year sentence for terror-related charges in the U.S. was sentenced to an additional 50 years in federal prison in relation to an assault against two corrections officers, the U.S. Attorney's Office announced Monday.
title: Ontario man convicted in U.S. terror probe gets additional 50-year prison sentence

description: Pope Leo will not ‌need any further therapy after undergoing ​lung cancer surgery ​last week, his doctors said in ​a statement released by ‌the Vatican on Wednesday.
title: Pope needs no further treatment for lung cancer, his doctors say

author: Abby Hughes
description: Developers behind the PHP programming language released a fix on Wednesday after a security vulnerability was brought to light. The PHP developers urged people to implement the fix as quickly as possible, and some governments took sites offline as a precautionary measure.
title: Canadian government sites among those offline after flaw identified in widely used computer language

description: Facebook parent company Meta has been ordered to pay $25 billion US after a jury found it misled consumers about data privacy.
title: Judge orders Meta to pay $25B US for misleading consumers about data privacy

author: Alexandra Mae Jones
description: As Nigeria reports its first case of Ebola, fears are growing that the epidemic that started in the Democratic Republic of Congo in May could be on the verge of becoming a bigger regional crisis.
title: Fears of a pan-African Ebola crisis growing as fourth country reports first case

author: Peter Zimonjic, Emma Godmere
description: Canada's outgoing ambassador to Russia has returned with advice for crafting a response to Moscow's "cognitive warfare" campaign against the NATO alliance and why keeping sanctions on oil and gas can frustrate Vladimir Putin's struggle to finance his war machine.
title: Canada's Russian envoy returns with advice on how to hit back against Putin

description: Air Canada customers who book their flights by phone are now paying $30 per passenger for the privilege.
title: Want to book with Air Canada by phone? That'll be an extra $30 please

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: If your feed is full of late '90s nostalgia and crying emojis, blame Dancing with the Stars, which during Tuesday's live dedication show, saw Julia Stiles pay tribute to her 10 Things I Hate About You co-star Heath Ledger.
title: Dancing with the Stars: Julia Stiles honours Heath Ledger with live tribute

author: Wallis Snowdon
description: People from across the community of Wainwright, Alta., lined the highway that cuts through town Wednesday morning to pay their respects to some of the soldiers at the centre of a weekend tragedy that left four dead and dozens more injured.
title: Wainwright residents pay their respects as soldiers leave town following deadly training exercise

author: Jeff Lagerquist
description: Bank of Montreal chief executive officer Darryl White says its a bad idea to give AI agents access to personal banking information like account numbers, passwords and PINs.
title: BMO CEO says don't give AI agents your banking info

author: Helen Surgenor
description: Janice STFU is the biggest hit Drake has released in years, but a lawsuit filed last week alleges the Toronto rapper stole the hook — an allegation his team strongly denies.
title: Drake denies stealing Janice STFU chorus

author: Annabelle Olivier
description: Quebec publishing house Éditions du Boréal announced Wednesday it is ending its professional relationship with Thélyson Orélien.
title: Publisher cuts ties with Quebec author accused of AI use in award-winning novel

description: Republican Vivek Ramaswamy's team has confirmed that it produced a controversial advertisement featuring the estranged mother of his Democratic opponent in Ohio's gubernatorial race — and that the campaign will spend $4 million US to promote it despite facing bipartisan rebuke for dredging up Amy Acton's painful childhood.
title: Ohio's Vivek Ramaswamy slammed for 'revolting' campaign ad featuring opponent's estranged mother

author: Ashley Burke
description: Prime Minister Mark Carney and Ontario Premier Doug Ford are expected to unveil new support for auto companies making clean investments during the trade war with the U.S., CBC News has learned
title: Carney, Ford to announce funding for clean auto investments: source

author: Allison Jones
description: Some Ontarians with Stage 4 cancer, whose doctors say they are good candidates for treatments unavailable in the province, were buoyed last month when a man won a court challenge against his OHIP out-of-country denial. But their hopes were dashed when Health Minister Sylvia Jones responded to the court ruling by changing the rules.
title: Ontario cancer patients speak out over disappointment with drug funding decision

description: Russian President Vladimir Putin hosted U.S. special envoy Steve Witkoff in a grand imperial palace on Wednesday to review new ideas on ending the war in Ukraine amid Washington's latest push to stop Europe's bloodiest conflict since the Second World War.
title: U.S. envoy Witkoff meets with Putin in Russia amid report Musk throttled Starlink

author: Jason Markusoff
description: After the referendum, the UCP leader hardened her support for a united Canada. Much of her base has other ideas.
title: Alberta separatists lost the vote. They'll continue their fight inside Danielle Smith's party

description: The Parti Québécois will unveil its cabinet of ministers on Wednesday during a swearing-in ceremony at the National Assembly. The ceremony will begin at 1:30 p.m. ET and CBC will provide live coverage.
title: What to know about Quebec's new cabinet ahead of swearing-in ceremony

description: Australian lawmaker Helen Haines has had both legs amputated after being rammed by a car outside her electoral office, her husband said on Wednesday, as the man accused of the attack appeared in court.
title: Australian MP loses both legs after alleged vehicle attack as suspect appears in court
More than 1.5 million Canadian Crime Stoppers tips leaked, CBC exclusive finds

author: Jeff Lagerquist
description: The Bank of Canada has not raised interest rates since July 2023. And while an eighth-consecutive hold is widely-predicted next week, a growing number of economists and traders are now expecting the central bank to hike its trend-setting rate to tamp down stubborn inflation.
title: Canadian housing market 'on its knees' as odds of Bank of Canada rate hike rise

author: Kate McKenna
description: Nearly six months after announcing plans to create a Canadian sovereign wealth fund, the federal government is still not sure when it will be launched, or how exactly it will work.
title: Carney government has no launch date planned for proposed sovereign wealth fund

author: Murray Brewster
description: Prime Minister Mark Carney heads to Turkey, seeking closer trade, energy and defence ties with a strategically important NATO ally. The historic visit marks a turnaround in relations once soured by a Canadian arms embargo. But Ankara’s crackdown on dissent tests Carney’s promise to balance economic pragmatism with Canadian values.
title: Carney’s Turkish balancing act must include business, defence and human rights

author: Myles Dichter
description: Canada has won just one Olympic figure-skating medal since 2018, a 2026 bronze from ice-dance duo Piper Gilles and Paul Poirier, who are taking the year away from competition. In charge of shepherding that next wave of talent to the Olympic podium is CEO Therese Brisson, who took over the role in July after spending six years in the same position at Alpine Canada.
title: How this figure skating season will 'set the stage' for Canada's next Olympic generation

author: Gloria Henriquez
description: A Toronto man is warning Canadians to think twice before sharing too much personal information with Muse, Meta’s AI agent that acts as a personal assistant, after he says it arranged a Marketplace sale without his knowledge and provided a stranger with his home address.
title: Meta’s AI agent Muse set up Marketplace sale without telling him — and gave out his address

author: Anand Ram
title: More than 16 years after BP's Deepwater Horizon disaster, marine life has not recovered

author: Dave Seglins, Andreas Wesley, Saloni Bhugra
description: Nearly 130,000 Ontarians now show signs of problem gambling, compared to some 43,000 in 2018, a tripling of the number of people who meet the criteria of gambling too frequently, losing money and struggling with addiction, CBC News has learned.
title: Problem gambling jumps, suicides triple in Ontario after expansion of online casinos

author: Wallis Snowdon
description: Soldiers badly burned when a fire engulfed a military training field face a prolonged and fragile recovery that will test the strength of Alberta's health-care system, warn doctors on the frontline.
title: Prolonged, fragile recovery ahead for soldiers severely burned at CFB Wainwright

author: Inayat Singh
title: UN retreats from 1.5 C global warming limit and proposes a plan B
